protocol.purpose: Exploratory validation-only matched class-weight comparison; not clinical early prediction or confirmatory testing
protocol.selection: First maximum validation macro_f1 rounded to six decimals over the complete fixed budget; no early stopping
protocol.class_weights: Use shared class_weights on full training labels only: sqrt(N/(30*n_c)); no validation weighting and no resampling
protocol.reuse_policy: Verify completed manifests, source snapshots, selection policy, cohort/label order, original checkpoint replay provenance, and recomputed selected metrics. Do not resume historical models under changed live sources. No neural retraining authorized.
protocol.ensemble_policy: Equal probability average across exactly three independently trained seeds, each selected with the same primary metric; separate rows from single-model mean and sample SD

uncertainty.method: Paired stratified-by-true-class patient bootstrap, same sampled patients for compared models
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on the fixed validation cohort, selected checkpoints and class supports; does not account for model selection or training uncertainty; class intervals are pointwise, not multiplicity corrected

protocol.rare_class_policy: Lowest training-support quartile: floor(30/4)=7 classes, stable class-index ties; existing validation-support <=100 grouping retained only as explicitly exploratory historical comparison
protocol.compute_fairness: Matched information, folds, weights, metric and seeds, NOT equal architecture, optimizer, compute budget or checkpoint-search count (30 GCHM epochs versus 1200 boosting rounds)
protocol.clinical_limitations: Native temporal_clean=false. History may include current/future diagnoses; whole-visit labs and stay-wide vitals are not availability-safe. External time-aware evaluation and clinical cost analysis remain required.

metric_semantics: Overall/subgroup metrics use shared/lib/metrics.py (6 decimals). Per-class zero precision/F1 denominators map to 0; absent-class recall is null. Class-group macro summaries use full-cohort one-vs-rest counts, so FP outside a rare group remain counted. Subgroup balanced_acc averages observed true classes; macro_f1 uses observed/predicted union. Empty subgroups are retained as null.
bootstrap_method: Within each true class, multinomial sampling of observed paired-prediction categories is distributionally identical to resampling patients with replacement: each patient's (prediction_A, prediction_B) pair remains together. Fixed class supports and paired confusion-count sufficient statistics reproduce accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro F1 and class recall without individual bootstrap indices. Percentile intervals use unrounded metrics and numpy linear quantiles.
bootstrap_scope: Conditional on the fixed validation cohort, selected checkpoints and class supports; does not account for model selection or training uncertainty; class intervals are pointwise, not multiplicity corrected
bootstrap_rng_policy: Reset the same protocol seed for each comparison, deterministic canonical order; comparisons are not independent.

limitations_tr: temporal_clean=false: geçmiş tanı alanları mevcut/gelecek tanıları içerebilir; tüm ziyaret laboratuvarları ve yatış-geneli vital özetlerinin karar anında erişilebilirliği doğrulanmamıştır. Bunlar klinik erken tahmin değil, sızıntı riski taşıyan doğrulama/rekonstrüksiyon sonuçlarıdır.
Ağırlıklandırma nadir sınıf recall kazanırken precision ve çoğunluk doğruluğunu düşürebilir; FP/FN ve precision birlikte okunmalı, klinik maliyet analizi yapılmalıdır.
Aynı doğrulama kümesi checkpoint seçimi ve raporlama için kullanıldı. Sabit seçilmiş checkpoint'lere koşullu bootstrap seçim yanlılığını veya eğitim belirsizliğini kapsamaz.
Bilgi, bölmeler, ağırlık politikası, metrik ve seed eşleşir; hesap bütçesi eşit değildir: GCHM 30 epoch, XGBoost 1200 tur. Mimari, optimizer ve aranan checkpoint sayısı farklıdır.
Güven aralıkları sınıf bazında noktasaldır; çoklu karşılaştırma düzeltmesi yoktur. Keşifsel sonuçlar doğrulayıcı üstünlük veya klinik kullanım kanıtı değildir.
test_evaluated=false; test tahmini/metriği üretilmedi. Harici, zaman-güvenli değerlendirme gerekir.

limitations.hx: Original upstream history, may include current/future visit diagnoses; NOT cleaned

limitations.labs: Whole-visit summaries/abnormal flags; result availability and units not revalidated
limitations.age_bmi: Native source anchors/documentation time not validated
limitations.medications_complaints: Source filtering/selected-stay lineage/availability not recovered by train-only fitting
